nom: COSRX Airy-Light Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50

avis.texte: this is not my "all over" sunscreen - I use it for spots where I want extra coverage, like my cheeks and brows (they're microbladed and need UV protection), and for touch-ups. it's perfectly clear, matte and smooth, so it's a great primer too! the best part is that it doesn't make my sensitive skin break out or sting. it's also travel friendly, but it would be nice if they started making a smaller size for that.

I am acne prone which limits me from most products, but this sunscreen didn't break me out instead it lowkey helped reduce it, the formula is great, and my dark spots started to fade which has never happened with other sunscreen.

avis.titre: Finally a sunscreen that feels like almost nothing
avis.texte: I was so sick of wearing tacky, sticky, oily, heavy sunscreens to walk my dogs. This is an absolute dream, a game changer. I love it. You can just barely feel it on your skin. It doesn't feel tacky once I put it on, and it's also water / sweat resistant which has been harder for me to find in sunscreens like this. Thanks to the stick form, it's so easy to apply, and I doesn't sting my eyes or irritate my skin either! If you hate heavy oily sunscreen, try this! I will keep buying forever.

I have used them all! Either has a white cast or greasy. Then I found this stick. It glides on beautifully. I use it for the top of my hands daily when I am outside or running errands. Great for travel and takes up no room in my purse. Highly recommend and will re-purchase.
I have acne prone skin, no pores clogged or redness with this sunscreen. No irritation at all! amazing.

The previous reviews for this sunscreen really got my attention, and I'm glad they did. The formula is so incredibly lightweight that I can barely even feel it while applying. There's no greasy feel, and it does NOT burn my eyes! I have been on the hunt for something that I won't feel on my face (hate that feeling) and won't burn my eyes when I sweat in the desert heat. I am so glad I gave this a chance. I will continue to use and repurchase it.
Airy-Light is the perfect name for this product. My skin even feels better with it on.
No breakouts or clogged pores. Easy application with smooth matte look. Ingredients are great for my sensitive skin, as most sunscreens irritate my skin.
This sunscreen goes on and is critical but invisible. It is not oily r sticky and coats your skin with a subnscreen. It's a lot in the tube and it's a great thing to have in your purse.

This truly is airy light. I have never seen sunscreen like this before. The product itself looked and felt so smooth like plastic I actually wondered if there was yet another plastic cover on top. You barely feel it as you apply it, no greasiness like other products. I actually think it helps mattify my skin after moisturizers leave it looking shiny. Also very compact so can pack it in purse for reapplication. I would definitely recommend this to others and continue purchasing it for myself
I'm loving this product. So far no breakouts and smooth finish. I appreciate all the ingredients in cosrx products.
I usually choose CosRX for sunscreen, so choosing this water resistant version was an easy decision. Applies smoothly, leaves no streaks and actually works!
I super love this sunscreen! so easy to apply and can fit in your pocket or small purses!

avis.titre: This is the best sunstick I've ever used!
avis.texte: It's not greasy, you can't even feel it on your skin, and you can apply it over makeup without ruining it. It's water-resistant and perfect to take anywhere. I absolutely love it! My sensitive, acne-prone skin loves it too. No breakouts, no clogged pores.
100% Amazing. So easy, so light, transparent. It's so portable too. Slips right into a purse or small bag. Nice price too. Cosrx prices are always so fair. Highly recommend.

Have to say, I have tried every sunscreen possible: they are either too greasy, burn eyes, smell to 'sunscreeny', leave a white residue, break me out, leave a red rash with my sensitive skin,or feel too heavy. This is hands down a keeper! Ingredients cause none of these problems. It is light and can even wear under makeup leaving a smooth texture or alone on a 10 mile hike, with no running in eyes! Fantastic!
Loved the sunscreen, it is so light. Not greasy at all, and very eary to apply.
